svg.title: Bandgap core schematic
svg.desc: Schematic view of Bandgap_Core.sch, including the reference, startup, folded cascode and bias circuits. All 490 wire segments and 197 symbol instances retain their source positions. Text is drawn upright. GF180 high-voltage PMOS geometry is used for pfet_05v0, preserving its source model label. Source SHA-256: 8495e03e2719bad0c11659aa68c36efbe879ec8743c3b4d5c628f17122432f0a.
